ResourceHeader.ResourceName: Hinode SOT-FG Level 0 Full-Stokes FITS Data (FGIQUV)

RevisionEvent.Note: Initial metadata creation and publication. SY

ResourceHeader.Description: The Hinode Solar Optical Telescope Filtergraph (SOT-FG) Level 0 FGIQUV FITS data product contains uncalibrated, three-dimensional image arrays acquired by the Narrowband Filter Imager (NFI; FITS INSTRUME='SOT/NB') in the shuttered full-Stokes observing mode. The product is identified by DataCode FGIQUV, OBS_TYPE='FG shuttered Stokes', and GEN_ID=3, distinguishing it from simple filtergrams and other polarimetric or magnetogram products. Each FITS Primary HDU contains a three-dimensional image array with four two-dimensional image planes corresponding to Stokes I, Q, U, and V. Spatial dimensions and angular pixel scales vary according to observing settings, including subframing and binning; the nominal unbinned NFI scale is approximately 0.08 arcsec per pixel. The observing passband is indicated by the WAVE FITS keyword, and FITS headers also describe exposure and image sampling. The Level 0 images precede scientific calibration.

Parameter.Name: Stokes I, Q, U, and V Images
Parameter.Description: Three-dimensional Level 0 SOT-FG NFI shuttered full-Stokes image data stored in the FITS Primary HDU. The first two array dimensions represent spatial image coordinates, and the third dimension contains four image planes for Stokes I, Q, U, and V. Observations are made in selected discrete NFI spectral-line passbands rather than across a continuous wavelength range; the selected passband is indicated by the FITS header keyword WAVE.
